```{r}
#| label: setup
source("_setup.R")
opts_chunk$set(dpi = cfg$daily_dpi)
days <- select_days(classification, cfg)
auto <- classification
auto$clasif_evento <- pipeline$automatic
corrections <- read_manual_corrections(cfg$manual_corrections_file)
```

Station `r main_lab`, `r cfg$year`. Each panel is one day: horizontal visibility (blue line; red dashed line, `r cfg$visibility_fog_threshold` m threshold), the classification of every 10-min record (band "Classif.": fog, dew or no atmospheric water) and the satellite fog and low clouds detection (band "FLC", dark when detected). A record is classified only when at least one collector registered water: as fog when visibility is below `r cfg$visibility_fog_threshold` m and as dew otherwise; when visibility is missing, as fog when FLC is detected and as dew otherwise.

For each half month, the first figure shows the automatic classification and the second one the classification after the manual corrections (`r if (is.null(corrections)) 0 else nrow(corrections)` time windows in total), followed by the windows corrected in that half month. Days shown: `r if (identical(cfg$daily_days, "aw")) "only days with at least one fog or dew record" else if (identical(cfg$daily_days, "all")) "every day of the year" else "selected days"` (`r length(days)` days).

```{r}
#| label: panels
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9

for (m in 1:12) for (h in 1:2) {
  p_auto <- plot_half_month(auto, m, h, days, ", automatic classification", cfg$visibility_fog_threshold)
  if (is.null(p_auto)) next
  p_corr <- plot_half_month(classification, m, h, days, ", after manual corrections", cfg$visibility_fog_threshold)

  cat("\n\n## ", month.name[m], if (h == 1) " 1-15" else " 16-end", "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(p_auto)
  cat("\n\n")
  print(p_corr)
  cat("\n\n")

  if (!is.null(corrections)) {
    win <- corrections %>%
      filter(month(start) == m, if (h == 1) day(start) <= 15 else day(start) > 15)
    if (nrow(win) > 0) {
      win %>%
        transmute(Start = format(start, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), End = format(end, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                  `Reclassified as` = recode(occurrence, !!!regime_labels)) %>%
        kable(caption = "Manual corrections (UTC)") %>%
        print()
    }
  }
}
```
